toeplitz_condition: [K_sigma(a_i-a_j)] is PSD for every finite real family
bochner_schwartz: the Toeplitz condition makes mu_sigma a positive tempered measure
local_division: for compactly supported phi>=0, set psi=exp(2 sigma u^2)phi; then psi is compactly supported and nonnegative, and <rho,phi>=<mu_sigma,psi>>=0
equivalence: rho is a positive distribution iff the fixed-width difference kernel is positive definite
no_width_limit: strict positivity of the Gaussian makes one width faithful; sigma->0 is unnecessary

status.bochner_to_weighted_measure: conditional on all finite Toeplitz PSD

acceptance_test: Choose one explicit sigma>0 and prove every finite Toeplitz matrix of the source-derived imaginary-character kernel PSD without zero-location input.
